title: Functional Passivation Interface of LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2 toward Superior Lithium Storage
notes: No introduction, methods or tables in the packet, so HYP/DES/PRC nodes are source=text with requires_unseen. Spine: PH3 conversion coating -> amorphous LiTMPO4 interface -> artificial CEI -> protected surface after cycling -> stable impedance, reversible phase transitions -> capacity, rate and voltage retention. Two parallel branches (interfacial transport: 0.11 eV Li barrier and metallic interface -> rate capability; surface protection -> cycling and voltage stability, itself forking at the two post-mortem structure claims) plus the thickness trade-off branch. Node count is high (52) because the packet carries 10 figures and 27 panels. Packet/paper defects: the F1 linked text refers twice to 'Figure 1g' but Figure 1 ends at panel f, and the 0.48 nm fringe and the 'no additional reflections' cross-check are both attributed to that non-existent panel; the F4 linked text calls the rate-capability panel 'Figure 4b' while the caption makes it 4c and 4b the 400-cycle test; the F4 caption puts the long-term test at 2.5 C and its linked text at 2 C; the F2 caption labels the fourth XRD trace 'vi' instead of iv; F2, F6 and F9 are offered as whole figures only (tiers C3_caption_swap, C3_caption_swap and C4_two_level) although their captions match the images; F1a-d are compared at three different magnifications; the F9/F10 linked text claims a spinel (Fd-3m) intermediate that no FFT in F10a is labelled with (audit o22).
